name: AICOSO Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
Dynamic Pricing by AICOSO is a powerful WooCommerce extension that allows you to create flexible pricing rules for your online store. Whether you need bulk discounts, special prices for specific user roles, time-limited offers, or category-wide pricing adjustments, this plugin has you covered.

Key Features

  • Bulk Discounts: Set quantity-based pricing tiers for products
  • Role-Based Pricing: Offer special prices to specific user roles (wholesale, VIP, members, etc.)
  • Time-Based Offers: Create flash sales and scheduled promotions
  • Category Rules: Apply pricing rules to entire product categories
  • Product-Specific Rules: Fine-tune pricing for individual products
  • Priority System: Control which rules apply when multiple rules match
  • Performance Optimized: Built-in caching system for fast price calculations
  • AJAX Support: Real-time price updates without page reload
  • Bulk Pricing Tables: Display pricing tiers on product pages

Use Cases

  • Wholesale pricing for B2B customers
  • Member-exclusive discounts
  • Flash sales and limited-time promotions
  • Volume discounts to increase average order value
  • Category-wide seasonal discounts
  • Special pricing for logged-in users vs guests
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicoso-dynamic-pricing-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Dynamic Pricing to configure your rules

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Dynamic Pricing by AICOSO”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, Dynamic Pricing by AICOSO fully supports both simple and variable products. Pricing rules can be applied to specific variations or to all variations of a product.

Can I combine multiple pricing rules?

Yes, you can create multiple rules and use the priority system to control which rules apply when multiple rules match a product. Higher priority rules take precedence.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, the plugin includes an advanced caching system that ensures pricing calculations are fast and efficient. Price calculations are cached to minimize database queries.

Can I show the discounted prices in the shop catalog?

Yes, the plugin updates prices throughout your store, including shop pages, category pages, and product pages.

Is the plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

The plugin is built following WooCommerce best practices and should be compatible with most well-coded WooCommerce extensions. If you encounter any compatibility issues, please contact our support.

Can I schedule pricing rules?

Yes, you can set start and end dates for time-based pricing rules, perfect for flash sales and seasonal promotions.

Does it work with guest users?

Yes, you can create rules specifically for guest users or apply rules to all users including guests.
